funding.name: HOPE Scholarship (Georgia)
funding.provides: The HOPE Scholarship provides tuition assistance to students pursuing an undergraduate degree at a HOPE-eligible Georgia college or university.
funding.eligibility: Graduate from high school with a minimum 3.00 GPA as calculated by GSFC, and maintain a minimum 3.00 cumulative postsecondary GPA; ten-year limit for students first receiving HOPE in summer 2019 or later
funding.how_to_apply: Program applications and award details are on GAfutures.org

funding.name: Georgia free college application month (application fee waivers)
funding.provides: Georgia high school seniors can apply to participating University System, Technical College System and private colleges for free throughout November through application fee waivers, with no limit on the number of schools.
funding.how_to_apply: Apply to participating colleges during November using the fee waivers

funding.name: HOPE Career Grant (tuition-free technical college programs)
